nodeData.topic: Session 01 · SB 8.20.8–9 · Putting Krishna First, Always!
nodeData.note: SB 8.20.8–9 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj teaches from Bali Maharaja's reply to Sukracarya that everything we gather is taken away in time, and only a good name remains: so what will we leave behind? Real greatness is not power or weapons but giving everything to a worthy person, and Bali sees the Lord Himself begging as a chance that hardly ever comes. Surrender means never sacrificing Krishna for anything, but sacrificing everything for Krishna, even at the risk of hell. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

nodeData.topic: Session 02 · SB 8.20.14–18 · How to Respond to Criticism
nodeData.note: SB 8.20.14–18 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj shows how a surrendered soul responds when cursed by his own guru: Krishna answers each person's desire, and Sukracarya, without love for Krishna, was used to test Bali, who passed. Worldly people cling to body, phone and money, but real self-preservation is of the soul, and a devotee's opulence is the Lord's gift. Cursed or blessed, Bali stays fixed and worships Lord Vamana's feet — whether praised or not, never give up Krishna consciousness. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.
